12 But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation. 13 Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms. - James 5:12-13 (KJV)

 James has been teaching about the persecution of believers by the ungodly world, so he is probably saying not to swear about your innocence in any manner. God will avenge His people (Romans 12:19), so we are not to strike out at those that persecute us, but just give it to God, and He will take care of it much better then we ever could. It is always better to just speak the truth, and not do a lot of swearing to the facts, just tell the truth. When one tries to defend himself with a lot of words, it is easy to claim things that are not true, or exaggerate them, and that will lead you into condemnation, of men, not of God, as we are not under God’s condemnation (Romans 8:1).

 If you are afflicted by the ungodly persecuting you, then you should pray for them (Matthew 5:44) to find God’s love, so they will not be ungodly. If you will get into the presence of the Lord by praying about your situation, you will be overcome by the fullness of joy, as being in His presence will cause it to happen (Psalms 16:11). James is telling us if you are merry, you need to sing songs about the Lord, and make your heart merry, as it will cure whatever problem you have, just like taking medicine (Proverbs 17:22). If we would all just show God’s love to those that hate us, and persecute us, then is when our light will shine for the Lord (Matthew 5:16), and they will see that we belong to Him (John 13:35). If you are full of God, who is love (1 John 4:16), then you can love your enemies with His love. Thank you Lord for the fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23).

I, Dolor, am God of Pity, Sorrow and Compassion. I watched The Cosmos unfold and since that time have wept for the pain that is bound to follow in any act of creation, as destruction is the only inevitable outcome. I weep for the actions of those who do not understand their own consequences, I weep for the sorrow inherent in this universe; my tears rain upon the cosmos as the light from far off stars and find those who most need to remember compassion in darkest times. I am He Who Cries For The Suffering of This Universe, and my 1,000 hands reach down into the darkest depths of the soul to rekindle the flame of compassion and love in those who have lost it.

Those who hearken to me learn of pity, compassion and endurance in hope. I offer counsel to all and shun none so long as they have but a glimmer of love left in their hearts; yet I often take hidden counsel with the evils of this universe in hopes of teaching them that to destroy is only to make room for new creation, and that to conquer is not to own, but to make one's self a slave of material possession.

My halls exist at the Gates of Twilight and are found only when the last rays of the setting sun intermingle with the first light of the moon. In my halls are recorded all that has taken place and thus are ever expanding so that they may make way for whatever new courses of action and history shall arise.

Darkness is my ally and my domain as in darkness is there ever need of compassion, yet I always walk partly in the light as that is what I ever try to lead others towards.

I give my counsel freely to all who seek me, in secret or openly, and I give my thought unheeded to those in whom I see the greatest capacity for compassion and the ability to strike sorrow from this universe. I exist only as needed, and shall a day ever come that the last rays of darkness descend from our universe, I shall undo my very being.
[New God] Dolor: God of Pity, Sorrow and Compassion
